{{Anchor2|id=back}}
Effects are the variety of mechanics some [[Unit List|Units]] are capable of doing in certain situations. Effects range from unit buffs, enemy debuffs, or economy.  

=='''Support'''==
*'''Income:''' Generate money after each wave.
[[Weather Girl (Thief)]] is different and can generate cash from her 'Treasure Thief' ability causing enemies to spawn with a glowing gold symbol on them which gives the player money on kill.
*'''Healer:''' Heals the base by restoring lost base Hp, or even giving extra HP to the base after each wave.
*'''Buff:''' Buff certain aspects of the unit such as Range, Damage, or SPA. Discounts given to upgrades from a unit also falls under this.
[[Commander]] can only buff Physical units while [[Wind Dragon]] can only buff Magic units. [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] can buff both Physical and Magic Damage. [[Oshy (Idol)]] is the only unit that can give discounts to upgrades for units.
*'''Debuff:''' Debuff enemies by making them take more damage from a specific attack type. 
[[Cursed King]] and [[Switchblade (Deception)|Switchblade]] can make enemies permanently take 20% more Physical damage. Although [[Blackhair]] can make enemies take 15% more Magic damage and [[Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow)]] can make enemies temporarily take 30% more Magic damage. [[Infinity Mage (Endless)]] can make enemies permanently take 30% more magic.

=='''Bleed'''==

* '''Bleed:''' Deals DoT (Damage over time) after hit and entirely stops the HP regeneration of enemies under the effect. Bleed stacks with other sources of Bleed from other towers. Additional damage is often 25%-35%, with some outliers dealing 50% additional damage in Bleed.  
* ''Note: The additional damage dealt from bleed is increased from buffs from units. 100% buff from either Commander/Wind Dragon or Griffin (Ascension)'s buff form doubles the percentage of additional damage and when stacking both buffs it will triple the percentage of additional damage. Example: A unit with 30% additional bleed damage will deal 60% with 100% buff and 90% with 200% buff.''

* '''Bleed Amplification:''' Units with Bleed Amplification make attacked enemies take 3.5x - 5x (dependent on the unit's upgrade) damage from all bleed sources for the duration of the effect (this does not extend the bleed debuff duration that negates regeneration).

* '''Summon Buffer:''' Units with Summon Buffer will increase the amount of HP summons spawn in with.

==How Each Effect Works==
===Enemy Effects===
*'''Burn:''' Deals DoT (Damage over time) for every hit. (Burn instances stack with other burn instances inflicted by other towers). The bleed deals damage based on a percentage the unit's base damage.
*'''Bleed:''' Deals DoT (Damage over time) after hit and it entirely stops the HP Regen of an enemy unit who has the ability to RGN (regen). (Bleed instances stack with other burn instances inflicted by other towers). The bleed deals damage based on a percentage the unit's base damage.
*'''Bleed Amplify:''' Units with this passive are able to Amplify the amount of Bleed Damage a bleed unit is capable of doing, the increase can range from 3x to 5x (varies based on upgrades). This passive is permanent (it lasts until the enemy dies).
*'''Wither:''' [[Ashborn (Decay)]] applies the Wither debuff when he attacks which applies a '''maximum 18 ticks''' of true damage and disables HP regen of enemies while the effect is active.
*'''Slow:''' Manipulates the speed of the enemies when hit by a unit with this effect, resulting in a massive decrease in the speed at which the enemy moves. '''(Has a cooldown of 7 seconds)'''
*'''Stun:''' Completely restricts movement of enemies for the duration of the effect. '''(Has a cooldown of 10-14 seconds)'''
*'''Cursed:''' Makes enemies take additional damage from magic damage. This buff can range from '''15%''' ([[Blackhair]] to '''30%''' [[Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow)]]).
*'''Confused:''' Makes all enemies in range walk backwards for '''5''' seconds.
*'''Knockback:''' Pushes enemy towards back the way it was coming from. '''(Has a cooldown of 30-31 seconds)'''
*'''Freeze:''' Completely restricts movement of enemies for the duration of the effect. The duration at which the freeze lasts is dependent on the unit which casts it. '''(Has a cooldown of 12-13 seconds)'''
*'''Shatter:''' Removes all shield instances on enemies when hit.
*'''Unconscious:''' Enemy is knocked out and stopped in place for '''3-4''' seconds.
*'''Dismembered:''' Causes the enemy to seemingly lose a body part and take increased physical damage permanently.
*'''Chrono Reversal:''' Similar to '''Confused''', makes all enemies in range walk backwards for 5 seconds. This ability also does 100% of the units damage in 5 ticks(20% per tick) to all enemies in their radius. '''Note that its a manual ability and it cannot work on bosses.'''
*'''Snatched:''' Each attack increases damage by 3% up to 33% (99% on a max upgrade) for 90 seconds.
*'''Mind Control:''' Forces enemies with a 10% chance in range to walk back for 1.5 seconds.
*'''Hexed:''' Similar to '''Dismembered''', Curses the enemy and increases their magic damage taken resulting in taking a permanent '''30%''' more magic damage.
*'''Poison:''' Deals DoT (Damage over time) for every hit.

===Unit Effects=== 
*'''Crit:''' A percent chance to deal/land a critical hit. When landing a critical hit the unit would deal 1.5x (+50% DMG) more damage and x2 Crit DMG (+100%) for [[Lex Akoman]].
*'''Over Crit:''' [[Sepsis (Moon)]] is able to do guarantees a critical hit on enemies that currently bleeding making his DPS increase by 50% consistently when paired with [[Saka (Ribbon)]].
*'''Motivate:''' Each attack buffs all allies in range by '''15%''' damage or '''10%''' range for '''10 seconds'''. This can stack independently with different durations, but same effects do not stack. However, this can stack with other buffs like [[Wind Dragon]]'s, [[Skeleton (Soul King)]], [[Commander]]'s, [[Blossom]]'s, [[Trickster (Release)]]'s or [[Elfy (Sylph)]]'s.
*'''Battlelust:''' Each attack that hits and enemy gives '''5%''' more damage buff for [[Karma (Thunder Fiend)]] with a max stack of '''25%'''. The effect will reset if the unit doesn't hit anything for too long.
*'''Curse Stack:''' Each attack that unit lands a critical hit that unit adds a curse stack effect after 4 curse stacks (dealing a critical attack x4) it can deal 200% more damage as {{Damage Type|True}} 
*'''True Damage:'''  {{Damage Type|True}} Damage units can ignore resistances/shields from enemies when attacking.
*'''Wild Card:''' Each of [[Mangaka (Artist)]]'s attacks will have one of these effects: Freeze/Slow/Knockback/Bleed/Burn at random.

==Trivia==  
*Before Update 8, stuns, freezes, and walkbacks didn't have a delay on different effects on each other.
